archiveTitle: 日报｜《Too Many Roaches》试玩版上线

decisions.headline: 《Too Many Roaches》Steam试玩版开放，目标消灭200万只以上蟑螂
decisions.summary: Heavy Feather Games于11月5日推出PC（Steam）试玩版，玩家要在夜间厨房中清除超过200万只蟑螂。
decisions.verification: 已打开4Gamer报道；仅采用首段明确可核的发行与玩法信息。
decisions.reason: 4Gamer正文首段明确确认试玩版、Steam平台、开发商与数量设定。
decisions.timeNote: 所选来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-05 19:07，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.titleEn: Satori Chunibyo Consultation Room: Translator of the Second Reality
decisions.headline: 《さとり中二病相談室》将于12月15日结束抢先体验
decisions.summary: 株式会社ファイン宣布这款心理悬疑冒险将于12月15日在PC（Steam）正式发售；11月13日17:59前的抢先体验价为1280日元，之后调整为1980日元。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON完整报道；价格与时间均限定为来源所述Steam安排。
decisions.reason: AUTOMATON正文明确确认正式版日期、平台及价格调整节点。
decisions.timeNote: 所选来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-05 11:09，位于本期固定窗口内。

decisions.titleEn: Catch All the Fish in the Sea
decisions.headline: 《海の魚、ぜんぶ釣る》Steam版定于12月8日推出
decisions.summary: ピース宣布短篇增量式钓鱼动作游戏将于12月8日登陆PC（Steam），定价800日元；游戏目标是累计钓起1亿条鱼。
decisions.verification: 已打开AUTOMATON完整报道；未将已上线的iOS/Android版与本次Steam日期混同。
decisions.reason: AUTOMATON正文明确确认Steam日期、定价与核心数量目标。
decisions.timeNote: 所选来源发布时间换算为北京时间2026-11-05 17:11，位于本期固定窗口内。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Too Many Roaches Demo Launches

entries.headline: Too Many Roaches Demo Launches on Steam
entries.summary: Heavy Feather Games released a PC demo on Steam on November 5, challenging players to eliminate more than two million roaches from a nighttime kitchen.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report confirms the demo, Steam platform, developer, and stated roach count.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 19:07 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Satori Chunibyo Consultation Room Leaves Early Access December 15
entries.summary: Fine Co. says the psychological mystery adventure will reach full release on PC via Steam on December 15. Its early-access price remains ¥1,280 until 5:59 p.m. on November 13, then rises to ¥1,980.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the full-release date, platform, and price-change cutoff.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 11:09 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Catch All the Fish in the Sea Comes to Steam December 8
entries.summary: Peace announced that the short incremental fishing action game will launch on PC via Steam on December 8 for ¥800, with a goal of catching 100 million fish.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report confirms the Steam date, price, and numerical goal while distinguishing the already available mobile edition.
entries.timeNote: The selected source was published at 2026-11-05 17:11 Beijing time, within the fixed edition window.
